interpolate_aria_pose: interpolate an Aria device pose from a closed-loop trajectory at a given capture timestamp
process_frame: process an Aria frame by undistorting the image and saving it with rectified camera intrinsics
read_frames_from_metadata: read a transforms.json metadata file and return a list of AriaFrame dataclass objects
storePly: store a point cloud with xyz coordinates and rgb colors to a PLY file on disk
calculate_timestamp_to_data3d: calculate the mapping of visible 3D point observations to their nearest camera timestamps
